race.comment: ROLL THE ACES (3) has the strongest overall profile despite being beaten over 15 metres in an NR up to 48 at Riverina Paceway last start, where he was tightened approaching the 1300m. His Albury 1770m record is a major asset and the season form reads well. THATS ME AGAIN (2) was sound when fourth, beaten five and a half metres, in an NR up to 44 at Shepparton last start and looks the progressive danger from that Victorian form line. GEORGES WORLD (1) won the last time he had the ace draw three back. He could do it again. BARWEN STORM (6) resumes from a two-month freshen and brings a proven track-and-distance record, with recent Riverina Paceway runs in NR up to 48 and NR up to 50 company keeping him firmly in the mix if he is ready to fire fresh.
